messages:
emma: Weird onboarding report: new users hitting rapid 429s in the quickstart even with low concurrency. dug in and saw the paginator prefetch was set to 4 in the sample code, and combined with the client-side window this floods the server when cursors are slow.

rishi: Prefetch=4? That can multiply requests. Is this the sampleapp default or something user changed?

emma: It's in the quickstart example snippet in the README. users copy it verbatim. snippet:
```js
for await (const page of client.paginateEmbeds({ pageSize: 1, prefetch: 4 })) {
  // process
}
```

emma: With prefetch=4 and quickstart concurrency=8, you effectively have up to 32 concurrent page fetches. If any page winds up hitting auth refresh or longer server latency, the inflight multiply and eat the rate window.

tom: Oof. That's rough for new users. Why was prefetch set that high in quickstart? Intended to hide latency during demos?

emma: I think it was meant to make the demo feel snappier but didn't consider rate budgets or backpressure. New users run quickstart locally against hosted API and think server is flaky when they see 429s.

claire: Two things we should do: 1) change quickstart snippet to prefetch=1 and add a short explanation about tradeoffs, and 2) expose a safe default in SDKs (max_prefetch=2) so sample code can't accidentally DoS small tenants.

rishi: Also add a client-side backpressure hook: if rate limiter enters "smoothing" mode, reduce prefetch dynamically. Could be opt-in initially.

tom: Agree. Short-term patch: update quickstart README + sampleapp config to set PREFETCH=1, and add a warning note in onboarding docs. Long-term: implement adaptive prefetch in SDKs (monitor remaining tokens and reduce concurrency/prefetch).

emma: I can open a PR to the samples repo to change the README snippet and quickstart flags. I'll also add a small local reproducer that shows how prefetch multiplies requests.

ci-bot: Created issue #4389: "quickstart: paginator prefetch defaults cause onboarding 429s" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/4389)

claire: Nice. For SDK parity page we should document prefetch semantics per SDK and the config knobs: prefetch, max_prefetch, adaptive_prefetch, and recommended quickstart values. New users often copy the example without reading the knobs.

rishi: Implementation notes for adaptive prefretch: use a sliding token estimate, track avg RTT per page, and only issue up to min(prefetch, floor(remainingTokens / costEst)). Fallback to 1 if token low.

tom: Also add an integration test in devex that runs quickstart with prefetch=4, concurrency=8 against a rate-limited stub server and asserts we hit 429s, then test with PREFETCH=1 shows no 429s. Makes regression catching easier.

emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/852 (reduce prefetch in quickstart + reproduce harness). please review.

ci-bot: Linked PR #852 to issue #4389

claire: We'll follow up with SDK leads to discuss adding adaptive_prefetch. For now, quickstart change + docs blurb should reduce noisy support tickets.

emma: Verified locally: switching prefetch to 1 removed the onboarding 429s for my reproducer. closing here and tracking work in GH. thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
